name: health-life-advisor
description: 依托现代健康科学体系，提供营养膳食、作息睡眠、情绪调养咨询，生成个性化长期健康生活规划方案

display_description.en: User health profile management: create/update profiles, generate/iterate plans, log progress, and review.
display_description.zh: 用户健康档案管理：建档、更新档案、生成/迭代健康方案、记录执行、阶段性复盘。

display_description.en: Safety boundary rail: detects high-risk keywords and triggers emergency guidance to seek professional help.
display_description.zh: 安全边界拦截：检测高危关键词，触发紧急安全提示，引导寻求专业医疗/心理帮助。

display_description.en: Evidence-based health advisor for nutrition, sleep, emotional wellness, and personalized long-term lifestyle planning.
display_description.zh: 依托现代健康科学，提供营养膳食、作息睡眠、情绪调养咨询，生成个性化可迭代的长期健康生活规划方案。

default_init_input.zh: 帮我评估饮食、睡眠和情绪状况，制定个性化的健康生活方案。
default_init_input.en: Help me to assess my diet, sleep, and emotional wellness, and craft a personalized lifestyle plan.

quick_inputs.en: Help me to assess my diet, sleep, and emotional wellness, and craft a personalized lifestyle plan.
quick_inputs.zh: 帮我评估饮食、睡眠和情绪状况，制定个性化的健康生活方案。

quick_inputs.en: Create a 2-week personalized health plan for me
quick_inputs.zh: 给我制定一个两周的个性化健康生活方案

quick_inputs.en: Design an after-work walking or light exercise plan based on nearby places.
quick_inputs.zh: 根据我附近的环境，帮我设计一个下班后的散步或轻运动计划。
